_about: The look of the HUD and menus, from the GDD's Art Style Guide (UI style: rounded cream and wood panels with a thin darker outline). Colors are the guide's palette, by name. Read by scripts/ui/ui_style.gd.

chalk._about: The HUD: chalk on little slate boards in wood frames, like the menu chalkboard by the door.

fonts._about: The guide's two fonts, both free to ship (SIL Open Font License, the licenses are next to them in assets/fonts). body: Nunito Bold, rounded and easy to read small, for everything (project.godot's gui/theme/custom_font is the same file, so 3D words use it too). title: Fredoka SemiBold, round and chunky, for the clock, recipe names, scores, pop-up words and screen headings. Empty keeps Godot's own.
